summary_1line: Before battle, Yudhishthira seeks blessings and strategic insights from Bhishma, Drona, Kripa, and Salya; Karna refuses Krishna’s offer; Yuyutsu defects to the Pandavas.

image_candidates.scene_text: Yudhishthira walks unarmed across the battlefield and bows at Bhishma’s feet while two vast armies watch in silence.
Krishna stands beside Karna on the battlefield, urging him to join the Pandavas as warriors and chariots wait behind them.
Prince Yuyutsu leaves the Kaurava ranks and crosses toward the Pandava army as drums and conches echo across the field.
